subject: general
question:
The variance of the seven observations 

6, 7, 10, 12, 13, 8, 14 is:
solution:
**Given:**

The seven observations are 6, 7, 10, 12, 13, 8, 14.

**Formula used:**

Variance (σ²) = dfrac{sum (X - mu)²}{N}

Where,

X = each observation

μ = mean of the observations

N = number of observations

**Calculations:**

Mean (μ) = dfrac{6 + 7 + 10 + 12 + 13 + 8 + 14}{7}</
